  cd /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update
  STEP=phase-1-operational-native-refinement-case-design-review
  bash "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh"

  git add -- CHANGELOG.md \
    "docs/reference/$STEP.md" \
    "tools/reference/$STEP.py" \
    "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh" \
    "tests/fixtures/reference/acceptance/phase-1/$STEP"-{confirmed375,step375-user-acceptance,design,policy}.json

  git diff --cached --check
  git commit -m "Phase 1 step 376: draft native refinement and complete case mappings"
  git push
  git status --short --untracked-files=all
  git log -1 --oneline
  git log -1 --oneline origin/main
)
